effects.effect: Your [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) increases by 21 and you can't be made [bleeding](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/bleeding) even while [dying](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/dying). You no longer age or have need of food. Additionally, you can use [Intuition](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/intuition) instead of another [characteristic](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/characteristic) when resisting [potencies](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/potency).
